title: A turn that wrote the site is looked at before it closes: the page the customer had open is drawn again and compared with the picture from before the turn; only a confident not_shown or broken, with both pictures of the same page, steers one notice; every other outcome is skipped with its reason and makes no claim
steps: S1: No stand, no browser, no model. Work in the TCH checkout at the commit under test, with its dependencies installed (pnpm install) and the deepseek-harness submodule initialised.

S2: From the checkout root run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/visual-check.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/visual-check-wiring.test.mjs — keep the ok/not ok lines and the exit code.
expect: S2: every test named in run.tests reports ok. A confident not_shown or broken steers exactly one notice whose source producer is tracy-site-tools:visual-check, with the page now as an image only when the session model reads images; shown, cannot_tell, an unreadable answer and shadow mode steer nothing; no write, no before picture, a before or after page not loaded, a comment pinned on another page, no image model, a capture failure or one past the budget, no image store, and a thrown error are each skipped with their reason. Through the shipped lib/index.js: a page drawn while the customer writes, then a writing turn that stops, is drawn again in the same window, compared once, and steered once; the step the notice adds is not checked again; shadow, off, viewContext off and a turn that wrote nothing steer nothing; a failing model never throws into the turn.

selectors.wiring: index.ts: turnAsks frozen in stepListener (views.take ready, takenAt before the turn), agent/turn-stopping listener (once per turn, agent.steer)

fence: Mechanism only: when the check runs, what it claims and what it steers. Not covered: whether the image model judges real pages well (a live measure on the stand, flaky by nature).

tests: visualCheckMode: on unless false or shadow
pageOf: one page per address — trailing slash, fragment and origin do not make another
commentPage: the page a comment turn was pinned on, read with the chat input’s own parser
turnWrites: only the calls of the last turn that changed the site
parseVerdict: the one JSON object, or nothing; a failure that points at nothing is cannot_tell
judgeMessage: both pictures, each named, and the reply given as a claim
checkNotice: a guess said as one, read before writing, honest even after "done"
🔒 a confident "does not show" steers ONE notice from this plugin, with the page now when the agent sees pictures
a text-only session is compared by the image model, and its notice carries no picture
shown, cannot tell, an unreadable answer and shadow mode: judged, no notice
🔒 no claim without both pictures of the right page, a write, a model or a picture now
the budget bounds the drawing: a page that does not draw in time is skipped, not waited for
🔒 never throws: a capture that throws is a skipped check
🔒 a confident "does not show" steers ONE notice, once per turn, after the page is drawn again
shown, shadow mode, a turn that wrote nothing: no notice
off: no listener work at all; viewContext off turns it off too
🔒 a model that fails never throws into the turn and steers nothing
